extracted.intended_audience: professional mathematicians and advanced students interested in analytic/modern geometry (polar reciprocity, conic sections, and reciprocal surfaces)
extracted.subtask_description: Exposition and worked examples on polar reciprocity in analytic geometry: methods for finding polar/reciprocal surfaces and curves (relative to spheres and general second-degree directors), and properties of reciprocal cones, envelopes, and developable surfaces.
